_comment: HLD test 18 throughput baseline. CI gate fires if measured throughput < threshold_pct * baseline. Update manually when an intentional perf change lands; do NOT auto-update (silent baseline drift defeats the gate's purpose).
_calibration_notes: Calibration history. (1) 2026-05-10 (v0.1): 250-sample x 20K-variant x 2-panel fixture (10M genotypes). Measured 31.9M g/s on `ubuntu-latest`; baseline conservatively pinned at 25M g/s (78% of measured) to leave noise margin for shared CI runners. (2) 2026-05-12 (v0.3.1): fixture bumped to 500 x 100K x 2 (100M genotypes, 10x larger) so the v0.3 hot-path vectorization wins are actually detectable (at the smaller fixture, fixed overhead dwarfed the per-row-loop savings). First measurement on the new fixture: 70.84M g/s end-to-end (1.41s merge wallclock; 854MB peak RSS). New baseline pinned at 65M g/s (92% of measured) — preserves the existing 0.80 threshold-pct convention, gating at 52M g/s = 73% of current throughput. Allows a real ~27% regression to trip the gate while ignoring sub-10% runner variance.
